capture_scope: Read-only aggregate of the active local gateway cache and its linked Codex run artifacts; no source bodies, credentials, prompts, transcripts or raw records are included.

methodology.selection: SELECT request_json,response_json,artifact_path FROM cache WHERE kind='classify' AND artifact_path IS NOT NULL
methodology.matching: Decode request_json; exclude message lengths above 16000; remove role; serialize the remaining request with Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')) using its default ensure_ascii=True; SHA-256 that UTF-8 string; group by response_json.model and the resulting digest; retain groups containing both filter and fast.
methodology.counting: For each matched role, read artifact_path/run.json and count success=true. Sum the integer fields reported in run.json.usage. Count turn.completed events in that artifact's events.jsonl without retaining or displaying event bodies.
methodology.matching_limit: The capture grouped by request fields and model, not by prompt version or research-context hash. If multiple cache entries have the same model/request/role, the last fetched row supplies that role. This is descriptive evidence, not a version-controlled benchmark.
methodology.time_boundary: observed_at was emitted at the end of the capture. SQLite rows were fetched first, then immutable completed artifacts were read; the runtime remained active and this is not an atomic cross-file snapshot.
methodology.usage_interpretation: Preserve named usage counters as reported. Do not add cached_input_tokens to input_tokens or treat cached response usage as new work. No dollar conversion was performed.

supported_observation: These matched leaf requests were classified separately by both filter and Fast, with one recorded completed turn in each successful artifact.
not_measured: Post-change production call counts or token usage
Exact billable backend request counts or dollar cost
Controlled before/after savings, latency, quality or downstream load
Distinct original-record counts for this leaf-request sample
All failed attempts or their potentially unreported usage
caveats: Leaf requests can be chunks of a longer original; the sample is not a count of short original records.
Only requests with both stages present enter the sample. Historical first-filter rejections are excluded.
A cache hit replays previously recorded usage; summing routing-event usage overcounts fresh model work.
Aggregate long-source cache rows have no artifact_path; cache row totals are not model-call totals.
Failed or rejected classifier attempts may leave run artifacts without a cache row; the matched successful sample excludes them.
A successful Codex invocation and completed turn do not establish the number of internal transport retries or billable backend requests.
Model, request, research-context or prompt-version changes invalidate gateway cache keys independently.
Removing a broad gate can increase embedding and later-stage traffic. This baseline does not establish total pipeline savings.
